title: About Maison Elara
content:
The Maison Elara Story

Maison Elara was founded on a simple conviction: that women in India deserve access to world-class luxury bags crafted at home, with intention, and without compromise.

We are a design-led atelier based in Surat — a city that has always understood the relationship between skilled hands and extraordinary material. We work with Italian leather sourced from Tuscan tanneries, Indian artisans trained in European finishing techniques, and a philosophy that values material integrity above trend.

Our Craft

Every Maison Elara bag passes through more than 60 individual handcrafting steps before it leaves our atelier. We use no shortcuts: every seam is hand-stitched where it matters, every hardware component is individually attached, and every bag is quality-checked by the artisan who made it before bearing our name.

Our Promise

We believe a great bag should last decades, not seasons. Vegetable-tanned leathers that develop patina. Hardware that doesn't tarnish. Linings that stay pristine. Stitching that doesn't unravel. That is what we make, and that is what we stand behind.

title: Leather Care Guide
content:
Caring for Your Maison Elara Bag

A well-cared-for leather bag is an heirloom. The guidance below will help your bag age beautifully over years of use.

Daily Care

  • Store your bag in the dustbag provided when not in use
  • Avoid direct sunlight for extended periods — it dries and fades leather
  • Keep away from sharp objects and rough surfaces
  • Never hang a heavy bag by its handles for extended periods

Cleaning

  • Wipe with a soft, dry cloth for dust and surface marks
  • For deeper cleaning, use a leather cleaner applied with a soft cloth — never rub vigorously
  • Always test any product on a hidden area first
  • Allow to dry naturally, away from direct heat

Conditioning

  • Apply a quality leather conditioner every 3–6 months to maintain suppleness
  • Vegetable-tanned leathers develop a patina naturally — conditioning enhances this process

Suede Care

  • Brush regularly with a suede brush to maintain the nap
  • Apply suede protector spray before first use
  • Treat water marks immediately with a suede eraser

Hardware

  • Buff with a dry, lint-free cloth to maintain shine
  • Avoid contact with perfume, body lotion, and cleaning sprays

title: Shipping & Returns
content:
Shipping

All orders are dispatched within 2 business days from our Surat atelier. Delivery timelines:

  • Metro cities (Mumbai, Delhi, Bengaluru, Chennai, Hyderabad): 3–4 business days
  • Tier 2 and 3 cities: 5–7 business days
  • International (UAE, UK, USA, Canada, Singapore, Australia): 7–14 business days

All domestic orders include complimentary tracked shipping via premium courier partners. Free shipping is offered on all domestic orders above ₹5,000.

Returns

We accept returns within 7 days of delivery. The bag must be unused, in original condition, with all packaging, dustbag, authenticity card, and tags intact.

To initiate a return, please WhatsApp us with your order details and reason for return. We will arrange a pickup from your address.

Refunds are processed within 5–7 business days of receiving the returned bag. Sale items, customised pieces, and international orders are not eligible for return.

Exchanges

We are happy to exchange for a different colour or style of equal or higher value. Exchange orders are processed within 10 business days of receiving the original piece.
